title: Lab reusable project module
objective: A reusable projects feature should encapsulate service, controller and store token in an explicit Nest module.
misconception: ProjectsController directly constructs its service, making the module hard to override.
acceptance: Resolve ProjectsController from a real Nest module and replace the store token for tests.
securityBoundary: An in-memory demo repository is not production persistence or multi-tenant authorization.
